changelog:
Version 2.0.1

- SKILL.md has been significantly expanded and updated to detail new features, workflows, and behavioral rules.
- Added support for record modification and deletion workflows, including smart syncing of reminders/automations.
- Enhanced reminder (自动化提醒) management—now includes fine-grained reminder time, single/reminder detection, and detailed rrule generation.
- All reply formats now require displaying both the event content and its unique ID to ensure users can confirm record accuracy.
- Data file path unified under a standard WorkBuddy directory for both PC and WeChat.
- Enhanced concurrency handling to prevent file write conflicts when adding records rapidly.
- Added README.md and removed skill-card.md for updated documentation structure.
